measured_data: Real anonymous elapsed-time harmonic-spacing measurements; no raw audio or original spectral pixels
search_outputs: Anonymous scalar corrected-time candidate scores; no actual flight identifiers, exact date/time or geographic coordinates
synthetic_data: Physics and sensitivity demonstrations explicitly synthetic
scope: Post-disclosure corrected-time search excludes supplied aircraft identity and observer coordinates as input; not a new blind experiment
private_reproduction: Full actual trace/terrain/weather/pixel reruns require separately private evidence bundle
